title: Legatto server update policy (legatto-policy/1)
description: Local policy of one office server: /etc/legatto/update/policy.json (root 0644), written only by Ansible inside a break-glass window, never by a release. Release documents can only make the outcome stricter. Minimum values below are the D7(b) floor and cannot be lowered. The office admin may additionally opt out of automatic security installs in the console (state in /var/lib/legatto/update/admin.json); the admin cannot enable them when auto_security is false.

env.description: test allows software release keys and a non-production update URL; prod does not.

update_base_url.description: prod: exactly https://updates.legatto.pl/v1. test: any mirror (plain http allowed; integrity comes from signatures and hashes).

signatures_required.description: Distinct release principals that must sign every manifest, promotion, index and KRL (D6: 1 now, 2 when two people hold keys).

auto_security.description: Install promoted security releases automatically inside install_window (P15).

index_max_validity_days.description: Reject an index whose expires - issued_at exceeds this.

clock_jump_block_minutes.description: A wall-clock jump larger than this between runs blocks installation and writes an audit entry.
